ruleName: Out of bounds and provisional ball
group: Out of bounds and provisional ball
title: What do you have to do if your ball is out of bounds?
question: If you find out your ball is out of bounds, what should you do next according to the rules?

choices.text: Drop a ball at the spot where your ball went out of bounds and keep playing.
Go back to where you played your last shot, play another ball, and add a one-stroke penalty.
Move the ball back in bounds and keep playing with no penalty.

explanation: When a ball is out of bounds, you must go back to the place you last played from, play again, and add a one-stroke penalty.
